findings.title: Ideation empty state said 'all five' for six categories
Footer advertised 'return apply' but j/k applies+persists immediately
Footer omitted G (force regen); g silently no-ops when roadmap exists
Sub-view selector 1-6 does not change the rendered sub-view or move the bar highlight when no agent is live
findings.detail: AgentsView.tsx:131 `empty ?` short-circuits before the sub===... switch, so all six sub-views render the identical AGENT SWARM empty panel. The selector bar at :122-126 does render highlight from `sub`, but a fresh unarmed session pressing 4 produces a pixel-identical PNG. Control: a theme change (pure color) DOES change the PNG hash, so the capture is color-faithful and this is not an instrument artifact.
